caption:
73% of small businesses have no analytics on their website.

That means they are flying completely blind.

Without analytics you do not know how many people visit your site — could be 10 or 10,000.

You do not know where they come from, so you cannot double down on what works.

You do not know which page makes people leave — and that page is costing you customers every day.

The fix? Google Analytics and Search Console. Both free. Both set up in 10 minutes.

Save this and set it up this week.
